bullets.text: Combined ratio was 90.9 vs 90.6 in 2018; Personal Lines CR was 90.5; Commercial Lines CR was 89.6; Property CR improved to 101.7 from 106.9; full-year 2019 ROE was 31.3%.
Companywide NPW grew 15% to $37.6B, adding nearly $5B; Personal Lines NPW rose 15%; Commercial Lines NPW grew 20%, adding nearly $800M from a $4B base; Property NPW rose 16% to $1.7B.

Portfolio return 7.9% with assets over $39B (fixed income 6.0%, equity 30.5%); quarterly dividends $0.10/share plus $2.25/share ($1.3B) additional dividend; conservative risk allocation entering 2020.
New campaigns included Motaur, small business, and “At Home with Baker and Emily Mayfield”; announced partnership with Quibi, Sign Spinner character, and articulated new Marketing Brand Promise.
Over the last decade, NAER was trimmed 3 points; claims LAE dropped over 1 point over ten years and nearly 3 points since 2006; claim handling audit quality scores stayed relatively flat.

Property retained $214.5M in catastrophic wind and hail losses, adding 13.8 points to Property loss ratio; rate increases and minimum deductibles instituted in hail alley states; monthly catastrophe disclosure added.
Personal auto PIF +11%; Special Lines PIF +4% after flat 2018; Property PIFs rose 14% to over 2.2M; mobile app customer engagement increased approximately fourfold since 2016.

Theme “Think Broadly” aligns with concurrently investing across Three Horizons for short-, mid-, and long-term success; articulated formula: Question Everything plus Always Grow Mindset equals an Enduring Business.

Agreed to acquire 100% of ARX one year early; shifted Property into Personal Lines; Commercial Lines expanding via BusinessQuote Explorer, BOP/GL programs, and transportation network company relationships.

Company has over 40,000 people and added 4,000+ employees in 2019; Board reached 50/50 gender balance; carbon emissions per PIF fell 7% (-57% over ten years); claims achieved highest culture and engagement scores.
